text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Afternoon classes are such a drag~. I 
wanna go home~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Flip-flip-flip-flip-flip-flip...!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So loud! Wait, a helicopter!? It's coming 
this way... You gotta be kidding me!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All hands on deck! Furl the sails~! Drop 
the anchor, we're makin' port--!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Misunderstanding! This is no watercraft; 
it is my private helicopter!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Who cares about the little details? India 
ink and soy sauce are basically cousins 
anyway, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
“......Huh? No, like, that makes zero 
sense? What is this situation even?”

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Found her! I brought her back while she 
was backstroking across the Pacific. I 
could hardly believe my eyes when I 
spotted her!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Once you switched to the front crawl, it 
turned into quite a good race!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I've wasted precious time! 
I must hurry to my meeting at once. You 
two, return to your classroom immediately!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah... what a drag. Let's go back.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what's with the ectoplasm look? 
Beating you up right now wouldn't even be 
fun.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Guess I've got no choice, I'll take ya to 
a good place.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: A good restaurant?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Sizzleee~)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Welcome! Table for one at 'Golshi's 
Yakiniku,' right this waaay~~!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Let the galbi, tripe, and beef tongue 
purge all that worldly stress right out of 
ya!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nah, we'll totally get yelled at, right? 
The smoke'll give us away instantly.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You lookin' down on "Golshi BBQ"? My 
"beloved ride" is meant for times like 
this, ya know!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Her ride... is a helicopter?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Its blades have a nickname, you know. 'The 
Glory Wings that Dispel Despair.' ...In 
other words, a ridiculously huge 
ventilation fan.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Let's blow away this damn smoke with this! 
Switch, ONNN!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (VRRRROOOOOOOOOOOMMM!!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That'll make it even more obvious!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chairwoman Akikawa found out immediately, 
and Gold Ship got a thorough scolding.
